422,000+ downloads. 13,000+ GitHub stars.

I'm truly grateful for everyone who's been a part of this beautiful journey!

Try it here: https://t.co/cQ8SO6WGWu
(4/4)

No subscriptions. No internet required. No audio sent to servers.

Instant dictation, AI-powered formatting, custom writing styles, and support for Mac, Windows, and iPhone. (3/4)

Something kept bothering me: why couldn't local speech-to-text models match the cloud?

So I started building purpose-built Speech-to-text models, and cleanup models. 

Somehow my models ended up topping huggingface leaderboards. (2/4) https://t.co/YmOhrYMO0l

AI dictation apps charge you every month just to turn your speech into text. So I built FluidVoice: free, open source, and powered entirely by AI that runs privately on your device. (1/4) https://t.co/jPZg3Km0ZZ
